an9.19:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] imaṃ bhikkhave, rattiṃ sambahulā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave, tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
an9.19:1.2: upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante, pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni,
an9.19:1.3: tā mayaṃ bhante, paccuṭṭhimha, no ca kho abhivādimha,
an9.19:1.4: tā mayaṃ bhante, aparipuṇṇakammantā vippaṭisāriniyo pacchānutāpiniyo hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā”ti.
an9.19:2.1: aparāpi maṃ bhikkhave, sambahulā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
an9.19:2.2: “upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni
an9.19:2.3: tā mayaṃ bhante paccuṭṭhimha, abhivādimha no ca kho āsanaṃ adamha,
an9.19:2.4: tā mayaṃ bhante, aparipuṇṇakammantā vippaṭisāriniyo pacchānutāpiniyo hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā”ti.
an9.19:3.1: aparāpi maṃ bhikkhave, sambahulā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
an9.19:3.2: “upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante, pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni,
an9.19:3.3: tā mayaṃ bhante paccuṭṭhimha, abhivādimha āsanañca adamha no ca kho yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajimha …pe…
an9.19:3.4: yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajimha. no ca kho upanisīdimha dhammasavaṇāya …pe…
an9.19:3.5: upanisīdimha dhammasavaṇāya no ca kho ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇimha …pe…
an9.19:3.6: ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇimha, no ca sutvā dhammaṃ dhārayimha …pe…
an9.19:3.7: sutvā dhammaṃ dhārayimha, no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhimha …pe…
an9.19:3.8: dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhimha, no ca kho atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjimha.
an9.19:3.9: tā mayaṃ bhante aparipuṇṇakammantā vippaṭisāriniyo pacchānutāpiniyo hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā”ti.
an9.19:4.1: aparāpi maṃ bhikkhave, sambahulā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
an9.19:4.2: “upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante, pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni.
an9.19:4.3: tā mayaṃ bhante, paccuṭṭhimha, abhivādimha, āsanaṃ adamha, yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajimha, upanisīdimha dhammasavaṇāya, ohitasotā ca dhammaṃ suṇimha, sutvā ca dhammaṃ dhārayimha, dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhimha. atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjimha.
an9.19:4.4: tā mayaṃ bhante, paripuṇṇakammantā avippaṭisāriniyo apacchānutāpiniyo paṇītaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā”ti.
an9.19:4.5: etāni bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha bhikkhave, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha, seyyathāpi tā purimikā devatāti.
